intro.title: Welcome to your sponsor portal
intro.description: This is your sponsor area. Use the header to head back to the main site or log out. Everything you need to manage your sponsored events is below.

welcome.title: Your sponsor dashboard
welcome.description: A quick read on your registrants across every event you sponsor, so you can see what needs your attention at a glance.

filters.title: Find what you need
filters.description: Narrow your view here. Switch between your sponsors, or search and filter the list, so you can focus on a single event or status.

list.title: Your events and registrants
list.description: Open an event to review the players registered under your sponsorship, confirm or reject them, and export the list when you need it.
